description_en: Queries the list of vRouters in a specified region
description_zh: 调用DescribeVRouters接口查询指定地域的路由器列表
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-vrouters --vrouter-id vrt-bp1lhl0taikrteen0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVRouters

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vRouter to query
parameters.name: vrouter_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the vRouter resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的路由器所属地域的ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
